        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); T=G['Test input']; I1=G['Demo pair 1 input']; I2=G['Demo pair 2 input']
O1=G['Demo pair 1 output']; O2=G['Demo pair 2 output']

def find_candidates(g, maxdim=9):
    """Windows where all non-bg cells are one color X except exactly one foreign cell.
       Also require the X-cells form a single 4-connected component."""
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=max(cnt,key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    out=[]
    def conn(cells):
        S=set(cells); st=list(S); seen=set()
        while st:
            r,c=st.pop()
            if (r,c) in seen: continue
            seen.add((r,c))
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                if (r+dr,c+dc) in S and (r+dr,c+dc) not in seen: st.append((r+dr,c+dc))
        return seen==S
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            for h in range(2,H-i+1):
                if i+h-1>=H: break
                for w2 in range(2,W-j+1):
                    if j+w2-1>=W: break
                    win=[[g[i+a][j+b] for b in range(w2)] for a in range(h)]
                    flat=[v for row in win for v in row if v!=bg]
                    cc=Counter(flat)
                    if len(cc)!=2 or cc.most_common(1)[0][1]<2: continue
                    dom=[v for v,n in cc.items() if n==cc.most_common(1)[0][1]][0]
                    exotic=[(a,b) for a in range(h) for b in range(w2) if g[i+a][j+b]!=bg and g[i+a][j+b]!=dom]
                    if len(exotic)!=1: continue
                    Xcells=[(a,b) for a in range(h) for b in range(w2) if g[i+a][j+b]==dom]
                    if not conn(Xcells): continue

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r_ in g for v in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    best=None
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==bg or seen[i][j]: continue
            col=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; b=set([(i,j)])
            while st:
                q=st.pop()
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p=(q[0]+dy,q[1]+dx)
                    if 0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W and not seen[p[0]][p[1]] and g[p[0]][p[1]]==col:
                        seen[p[0]][p[1]]=True; b.add(p); st.append(p)
            rr0=min(a for a,_ in b); rr1=max(a for a,_ in b)
            cc0=min(c for _,c in b); cc1=max(c for _,c in b)
            win=[row[cc0:cc1+1] for row in g[rr0:rr1+1]]
            cnts=Counter(win[a_][b_] for a_ in range(len(win)) for b_ in range(len(win[0])))
            # majority within window (excluding bg) 
            fgc={v:c for v,c in cnts.items() if v!=bg}
            dom=max(fgc,key=fgc.get)
            o=[r_[::1] for r_ in win]
            nb=sum(1 for a_ in range(len(win)) for b_ in range(len(win[0])) if win[a_][b_]==dom)
            area=len(win)*len(win[0])
            key=(-area,nb)
            if best is None or key<best[0]:
                best=(key,o)
    return best[1]

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    got=f(G[k+' input']); want=G[k+' output']
    print(k,'match:',got==want)
print('TEST:',json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
